name: (08) Temporis — 3 Advanced — Hall of Hades' Court

system.description:
At this height of mastery the wielder of Temporis is no longer bound to warp time about a single subject. She can stretch or compress the flow of time throughout an enclosed space and everyone within it — drawing out a single night into days of parley, or dozing away a few drowsy moments in her haven while a whole day races past outside.

Spend one Blood Trait per hour of normal time the power will affect, then succeed at a Static Physical Challenge (retest Occult); as with all Temporis, Traits bid must be Stamina-related. For each Trait successfully risked, shift the time-dilation effect one step along the table, speeding or slowing time within a single enclosed structure no larger than a high-school gymnasium, for the vampire and all its occupants. Beware the Discipline's price: any failed use of Advanced Temporis inflicts an aggravated wound for each consecutive failure after the first.
